Key.Original: AEE pins the camera aperture and owns the eye adaptation rate. Off hands the camera back to the engine.
Key.English: AEE pins the camera aperture and owns the eye adaptation rate. Off hands the camera back to the engine.

Key.Original: Eye Adaptation
Key.English: Eye Adaptation

Key.Original: Scale on the engine ambient term, no unit. Engine mapping: getLightingAt has no documented unit, so the scale has no physical value.
Key.English: Scale on the engine ambient term, no unit. Engine mapping: getLightingAt has no documented unit, so the scale has no physical value.

Key.Original: Ambient Light Scale
Key.English: Ambient Light Scale

Key.Original: Scale on the engine blinding term, no unit. Engine mapping: apertureParams blinding has no documented unit, so the scale has no physical value. Default 0, off until tuned.
Key.English: Scale on the engine blinding term, no unit. Engine mapping: apertureParams blinding has no documented unit, so the scale has no physical value. Default 0, off until tuned.

Key.Original: Blinding Light Scale
Key.English: Blinding Light Scale

Key.Original: Weight of the fast pupil branch in the adapted luminance, 0 to 1. Operator preference, not a physical quantity.
Key.English: Weight of the fast pupil branch in the adapted luminance, 0 to 1. Operator preference, not a physical quantity.

Key.Original: Fast Pupil Blend
Key.English: Fast Pupil Blend

Key.Original: Scale on the engine local term, no unit. Engine mapping: getLightingAt has no documented unit, so the scale has no physical value.
Key.English: Scale on the engine local term, no unit. Engine mapping: getLightingAt has no documented unit, so the scale has no physical value.

Key.Original: Local Light Scale
Key.English: Local Light Scale

Key.Original: Mesopic luminance at and above which vision is fully photopic (m = 1), cd/m2. CIE 191:2010 MES2: 5 cd/m2.
Key.English: Mesopic luminance at and above which vision is fully photopic (m = 1), cd/m2. CIE 191:2010 MES2: 5 cd/m2.

Key.Original: Mesopic Upper Bound
Key.English: Mesopic Upper Bound

Key.Original: Mesopic luminance at and below which vision is fully scotopic (m = 0), cd/m2. CIE 191:2010 MES2: 0.005 cd/m2.
Key.English: Mesopic luminance at and below which vision is fully scotopic (m = 0), cd/m2. CIE 191:2010 MES2: 0.005 cd/m2.

Key.Original: Mesopic Lower Bound
Key.English: Mesopic Lower Bound

Key.Original: Age of the observer, years. Disability glare from bright sources rises steeply with age, as 1 + (A/70)^4 in the CIE age-adjusted Stiles-Holladay equation.
Key.English: Age of the observer, years. Disability glare from bright sources rises steeply with age, as 1 + (A/70)^4 in the CIE age-adjusted Stiles-Holladay equation.

Key.Original: Observer Age
Key.English: Observer Age

Key.Original: Pupil constriction time constant, seconds. TRACED: Meethal 2021 Sci Rep 11:21090, 0.25 s.
Key.English: Pupil constriction time constant, seconds. TRACED: Meethal 2021 Sci Rep 11:21090, 0.25 s.

Key.Original: Pupil Constriction Time
Key.English: Pupil Constriction Time

Key.Original: Pupil redilation time constant, seconds. TRACED: Meethal 2021 Sci Rep 11:21090, redilation 1.9 times the constriction.
Key.English: Pupil redilation time constant, seconds. TRACED: Meethal 2021 Sci Rep 11:21090, redilation 1.9 times the constriction.

Key.Original: Pupil Redilation Time
Key.English: Pupil Redilation Time

Key.Original: Assumed scene reflectance for the luminance step, 0 to 1. The photographic mid-grey, 0.18 (Kodak Gray Card R-27), stands in for the scene.
Key.English: Assumed scene reflectance for the luminance step, 0 to 1. The photographic mid-grey, 0.18 (Kodak Gray Card R-27), stands in for the scene.

Key.Original: Scene Reflectance
Key.English: Scene Reflectance

Key.Original: Cone-pool dark adaptation time constant, seconds. Cone photopigment regenerates with a time constant of about 2 min (Hollins and Alpern 1973, J. Gen. Physiol. 62:430), consistent with the cone-rod break at 5 to 8 min (Hecht, Haig and Chase 1937).
Key.English: Cone-pool dark adaptation time constant, seconds. Cone photopigment regenerates with a time constant of about 2 min (Hollins and Alpern 1973, J. Gen. Physiol. 62:430), consistent with the cone-rod break at 5 to 8 min (Hecht, Haig and Chase 1937).

Key.Original: Cone Dark Adaptation Time
Key.English: Cone Dark Adaptation Time

Key.Original: Rod-pool dark adaptation time constant, seconds. TRACED: Rushton 1961 J Physiol 156:166, 400 s.
Key.English: Rod-pool dark adaptation time constant, seconds. TRACED: Rushton 1961 J Physiol 156:166, 400 s.

Key.Original: Rod Dark Adaptation Time
Key.English: Rod Dark Adaptation Time

Key.Original: Light-adaptation time constant, seconds. No single published perceptual value exists, so this is an operator preference, 2.0 s.
Key.English: Light-adaptation time constant, seconds. No single published perceptual value exists, so this is an operator preference, 2.0 s.

Key.Original: Light Adaptation Time
Key.English: Light Adaptation Time

Key.Original: Log eye-adaptation diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.
Key.English: Log eye-adaptation diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.

Key.Original: Eye Debug Log
Key.English: Eye Debug Log
